name: Paraguay
description:
A landlocked South American country with a relaxed pace of life, low taxes, and exceptionally easy pathways to residency. Highly popular with passive income earners.

## Key Highlights
- Extremely low flat 10% tax rate on local personal and corporate income
- Very accessible temporary and permanent residence programs with minimal requirements
- Low cost of living and rich Guarani-Spanish bilingual culture
longdescription: Paraguay is a landlocked nation in South America, bordered by Argentina, Brazil, and Bolivia. Often called the 'Heart of South America,' it is characterized by vast plains, subtropical forests, and the dry Chaco region. The capital, Asunción, is a quiet, low-rise city combining colonial buildings with modern commercial centers along the Paraguay River. Paraguay has a low-tax economy, driven by agriculture, livestock, and clean energy exports generated by massive hydroelectric dams like Itaipu. Spanish and Guaraní are official languages, with Guaraní spoken widely by all classes. The country offers a slow, relaxed pace of life, low crime rates outside specific borders, and an extremely low cost of living. Paraguay is internationally renowned for having some of the world's most accessible residency laws, offering a direct path to temporary and permanent residency.

visas.name: Paraguay Temporary Residence Permit
visas.description: Paraguay's entry residence permit allows foreign nationals to live and work in the country for up to two years, with minimal document requirements.
benefits: Live and work legally in Paraguay
Low cost of living and easy processing
Exempt from taxes on foreign source income
visas.path_to_residency_description: Must hold temporary residence for 2 years before applying for permanent residency.

visas.name: Paraguay Permanent Residence Permit
visas.description: A permanent residence permit available after holding temporary residence for 2 years, or directly through the SUACE investment program ($70,000 minimum business investment).
benefits: Eligible to apply for citizenship after 3 years
visas.path_to_residency_description: Grants permanent resident status with immediate ID card access.
required_documents: Company charter or proof of property purchase

Citizenship by Descent.desc: Acquired if born to a parent who is a citizen of Paraguay.

Naturalization.desc:
**Requirements:** 3 years continuous residency as a permanent resident, clean criminal record, basic knowledge of Spanish and Paraguayan history/constitution, renunciation of other citizenships.

**Processing:** Through Supreme Court of Justice, 12-24 months.

tax_advice:
- Flat 10% personal income tax rate on local income
- Flat 10% corporate income tax rate
- Flat 10% Value Added Tax (VAT) rate (reduced rate of 5% on real estate/pharmaceuticals)
- Foreign source income is entirely tax-free (territorial tax system applies to individuals)
- No inheritance tax, wealth tax, or capital gains tax on foreign investments
local_tips:
- Spanish and Guaraní are official; Spanish is used for all administration and business
- Guarani (PYG) is the currency; cash is widely used, and credit cards are standard in Asunción supermarkets
- Healthcare: private system is affordable; private insurance (e.g. Asismed) is recommended
- Cost of living is very low; budget $800-1,500/month for a high-quality lifestyle in Asunción or Encarnación
- Internet: fiber optic speed is fast in Asunción, but spotty in rural Chaco regions
